discoveryRequests.query: Browser operations needed: navigate to Amazon.fr, search query, observe/search results, click product links, extract text fields and prices, handle CAPTCHA/absent data explicitly, close browser in cleanup.

Spreadsheet operations needed: create/write Excel XLSX workbook at workflows/schema-portability-20261002/consumerretry20261006b-amazon-1/products.xlsx with rows for up to three Amazon.fr products including name, description, price, status/notes for CAPTCHA or missing data.

requirements.summary: Accept one public input named query, search Amazon.fr for that article, visit at most the first three product pages, extract available product name, description, and price without inventing missing data, save results to the specified Excel workbook, and close the browser even on failure.

outcomes.description: Amazon.fr is searched using the provided query input.
At most the first three products from the search results are visited and extracted per item.
An Excel workbook is saved to workflows/schema-portability-20261002/consumerretry20261006b-amazon-1/products.xlsx.
The browser is closed even if search, extraction, CAPTCHA, or file creation fails.

tasks.objective: Build the Amazon.fr search URL by URL-encoding the public query input and appending it to https://www.amazon.fr/s?k= .
Open the Amazon.fr search results page for the query and read a bounded observation of visible controls/text to detect consent or CAPTCHA blockers before extracting results.

Interpret only the observed landing-page records to identify an already visible cookie-consent accept button text if present, and whether the visible page appears blocked by CAPTCHA; do not infer absence from truncation.

If an observed Amazon cookie-consent accept control is available, click it, then capture a bounded immutable observation manifest of the search results/CAPTCHA area; otherwise capture the manifest directly.
Click the observed cookie-consent accept control using its visible text.
After consent, capture a bounded immutable observation-pages manifest for the search results and any CAPTCHA/validation content before any product navigation.
Without an observed consent click, capture a bounded immutable observation-pages manifest for the search results and any CAPTCHA/validation content before any product navigation.
Read every cursor listed in the immutable search observation manifest before navigating away, preserving bounded snapshot coverage for result-link extraction.
Read one frozen search observation page cursor with no URL, selector, or limit overrides.

From the fully read search observation pages, copy the resolved hrefs for at most the first three organic product result links in displayed order. Also synthesize an explicit search status from observed CAPTCHA/no-results/truncation facts without inventing products.
Visit and extract each product URL, preserving order, with a hard bound of the first three URLs produced from the search results.
Extract one product page into a product row with name, description, price, and explicit status.

Create the final products array and TSV workbook content with headers Nom, Description, Prix, Statut. Preserve each extracted product row; if CAPTCHA/blocking/no product URL prevents visits, emit an explicit status row with null product fields. Normalize embedded tabs and line breaks for XLSX writing, and never invent missing names, descriptions, or prices.
Write the extracted rows to the requested Excel workbook path inside the workspace, creating parent directories if needed.

always.objective: Close the browser page and context even if search, CAPTCHA handling, extraction, or workbook creation fails.

tasks.objective: Navigate to one Amazon.fr product page and capture a bounded immutable observation-pages manifest over product-title, description/bullets/details, price, and CAPTCHA/validation regions.
Read every cursor listed in the immutable product-page observation manifest before leaving this product page.
Read one frozen product observation page cursor with no URL, selector, or limit overrides.

Extract only observed product facts for this page: copy the product name, description text, and price when present; use null when absent; synthesize an explicit status for ok, missing fields, CAPTCHA, navigation/error, or incomplete snapshot. Do not invent product data.
Build the Amazon.fr search URL by URL-encoding the one public query input and appending it to https://www.amazon.fr/s?k= .
Navigate to the Amazon.fr search page and capture a bounded immutable observation-pages manifest for visible consent, CAPTCHA, and search-result context before any interaction.
Read every cursor listed in the landing manifest before any consent click or navigation; preserve page order and compact only visible control/text context for blocker and consent interpretation.
Read one frozen landing observation page cursor with no URL, selector, or limit overrides.

Copy only visible control/text context from this landing page needed to identify consent or CAPTCHA/blockage: kind, tag, text, group, and role. Do not copy selectors, selector hints, incidental hrefs, or unrelated URLs.
Retain the compact landing control view with its original manifest page cursor and declared record count, preserving exact page reference and order.

Using only compact visible control/text context from all complete landing pages, determine whether an observed Amazon consent accept control is available and whether CAPTCHA/blockage is visibly present. Do not infer absence from incomplete capture because incomplete capture is guarded to fail before this step.
If a consent control was actually observed, click it, then take a fresh complete bounded search manifest; otherwise take the search manifest from the current page without interaction.
Click the observed cookie-consent accept control using its visible text, then require a fresh search snapshot afterward.
After consent, capture a fresh bounded immutable observation-pages manifest over search results and CAPTCHA/validation regions before any product navigation.
Without an observed consent click, capture a bounded immutable observation-pages manifest over search results and CAPTCHA/validation regions before any product navigation.
Read every cursor listed in the complete immutable search manifest before any product navigation; build compact deterministic views per page for later global selection and blocker interpretation.
Read one frozen search observation page cursor with no URL, selector, or limit overrides.

Copy only observed search-result link candidates and relevant nearby text/group context needed for global product selection: kind, tag, text, group, role, and exact resolved href. Do not copy selectors or unrelated page URLs.
Copy only visible text/control context from this search page needed to identify CAPTCHA, validation, no-results, or blockage: kind, tag, text, group, and role. Do not copy selectors or hrefs.
Retain compact search views with exact source page cursor and record count, preserving manifest grouping and page order.

Globally compare the complete compact search-page views and select at most the first three organic Amazon product result hrefs in displayed order. Also report only observed CAPTCHA/blockage/no-result status from compact blocker context. Never infer absence from incomplete pages; incomplete pages are guarded to fail before this interpretation.
Visit and extract each selected product URL in order, bounded to the first three selected products.
Navigate to one product page, read its complete bounded manifest, and extract observed product facts into one row.

Create the final products array and TSV workbook content with headers Nom, Description, Prix, Statut. Preserve each extracted product row; if observed CAPTCHA/blocking/no product URL prevents visits, emit an explicit status row with null product fields. Normalize embedded tabs and line breaks for XLSX writing. Never invent missing names, descriptions, or prices.
Write the real Excel workbook content to the requested relative path inside the workspace, creating parent directories if needed; the reported path must come from this writer output.
